instruction: A folk-art pelican whittled from a single billet of butternut, standing upright with a deep gular pouch bulging beneath an oversized flat bill. Broad gouge facets cover the body, and the wood grain sweeps up through the neck with darker heartwood streaks along the wing edges. Hand-painted black glass-bead eyes and a lightly waxed satin finish complete it.
